=== 1. model exploitation: predicted terminal cost ‖ẑ_H − z_goal‖² ===

  -> the model believes CEM's plan beats the expert's by x1.7
  -> CEM 'beats' the expert on 62% of segments

=== 2. cost/subgoal mismatch ===
  first-waypoint error vs the true frame:
    CEM subgoal      : median     21.45
    expert           : median     20.31
  corr(terminal cost, first-waypoint error): Spearman +0.450   Pearson +0.481
    (n=16: |r| > 0.54 is significant at p=0.05; Spearman is NOT significant.
     Positive r means lower cost goes with a better subgoal, i.e. the
     horizon-2 objective is not actively selecting bad subgoals.)
